description: This file contains functions and regex patterns for parsing and comparing release versions, resolving publish plans, and managing npm distribution tag authentication. It appears to be part of a build or release automation script related to npm package publishing and version handling.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured object with version details, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two release version strings, returning a sign indicating their chronological order or null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the appropriate npm publish plan based on the version and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines authentication source for npm dist tag mirroring based on provided tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Checks if npm dist tag mirror authentication is required based on mode, tags, and existing auth.
